setup.lead: One phone in the middle of the table runs the whole game. No moderator needed.
setup.seatingHint: Put players in order clockwise around the table. Drag ≡ to move someone.

errors.wrongTotal: Roles must match the number of players.
errors.tooManyKillers: Killers must be fewer than half the players.
errors.tooManySpecials: There are more roles than players.
errors.alphaNeedsPack: The Alpha needs at least 2 wolves in the pack.
errors.cubNeedsPack: The Wolf Cub needs at least 2 wolves in the pack.

warnings.favorsVillage: This setup strongly favors the village.
warnings.favorsWolves: This setup strongly favors the wolves.
warnings.bigPack: The pack is a third of the table or more.
warnings.smallTableTwist: Cupid and the Tanner work best with 7+ players.
warnings.earlySerialKiller: The Serial Killer works best with 9+ players.
warnings.noVillagers: With no plain villagers, bluffing gets hard.
warnings.manyInfoRoles: Lots of information roles make the wolves easy to find.

setup.narratorSub: Reads the night aloud. Turn it off to narrate yourself.
setup.surprisePitch: A random balanced mix of roles. Nobody knows what's coming.

villager.name: Villager

cupid.name: Cupid

mayor.name: Mayor
mayor.ability: Everyone knows you. You break ties in the vote.

lycan.name: Lycan
lycan.ability: You're a villager, but the Seer sees you as a werewolf.

cursed.name: Cursed
cursed.ability: If the wolves attack you, you become one of them.

serialKiller.name: Serial Killer
serialKiller.ability: Kill one player every night. Wolves can't kill you.

setup: Put the phone in the middle of the table and enter the players in seating order, clockwise.
Pick a recommended setup, or choose every role yourself with Custom.
Adjust the house rules, like the discussion timer, if you want.
play: Discovery: each player holds the seal to see their secret role, then passes the phone on.
Night: everyone closes their eyes. The wolves open theirs and silently agree on a victim.
Then the phone goes around the table: everyone takes a secret turn, even with no power, so nobody can tell who's who.
Morning: find out who didn't survive the night.
Day: talk it over, then point at who you think is a werewolf. The village banishes one player.
The village wins when every wolf is gone; the wolves win when they equal the rest of the village.
